integrity: The proof is a self-contained all-parameter mathematical argument, supplemented but not replaced by exact finite verification. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The formula applies to fan graphs with at least three path vertices and the inherited zero-sum Euclidean metric; no claim of absolute publication priority. A graph-Lipschitz-variance alias remains a possible literature overlap.
title: Sharp Euclidean facet-distance spectrum and inball-center parity for fan-graph symmetric edge polytopes
